title: Exhaustive width-eight A0 scalar minimality
statement: Axeyum exhaustively enumerates the Chapter 13 A0 add-two language through cost two and replays every candidate, establishing minimum instruction count two at width eight within that declared language.

formal.statement: enumerate the exact six-instance alphabet at costs 0, 1, and 2; execute all 1 + 6 + 36 programs on all 256 width-eight inputs; require r0_out = r0_in + 2 mod 256 and running completion

scope: Width eight; exact six-instance Chapter 13 mov/add alphabet; r0 writable and r1 read-only with value one; other registers zero, empty memory, pc zero, and running outcome; instruction-count costs zero through two; observe final r0 and running completion.

evidence.note: The complete strata contain 1, 6, and 36 syntactic candidates, 1, 5, and 11 behavior classes, and 0, 0, and 4 correct candidates. A separate tested control mutates the witness and fails at input one.

axeyum.route: bounded A0 scalar minimality by complete enumeration
